definitions.explanation: An organization that has joined a larger federation, league, or alliance as a member.

examples.japanese: {加盟団体|かめいだんたい}が{増|ふ}えた。
examples.english: The number of member organizations increased.

examples.japanese: {各|かく}{加盟団体|かめいだんたい}の{代表|だいひょう}が{集|あつ}まった。
examples.english: Representatives of each member organization gathered.

examples.japanese: この{連盟|れんめい}には{全国|ぜんこく}から{百|ひゃく}を{超|こ}える{加盟団体|かめいだんたい}が{参加|さんか}している。
examples.english: This federation has over a hundred member organizations participating from across the country.

notes:
Written {加盟|かめい} (joining, affiliation) + {団体|だんたい} (organization, body). Common in contexts involving leagues, federations, and international bodies.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {加盟国|かめいこく}: member nation — the same {加盟|かめい} applied to countries (e.g. of the UN)
- {会員|かいいん}: member — refers to an individual member rather than an organization
